resources.string: YouTube only for kids, without annoying ads

In kids mode the phone stays inside YouTube: any other app closes at once and YouTube comes back, links from inside YouTube don’t open, and the notification shade doesn’t open. It also taps “Skip” on YouTube ads automatically and mutes the ad. Only the parent PIN exits. The app collects no data and never connects to the internet.
Turn on “KidLock — YouTube” in Accessibility settings. If you see “Restricted setting”: open App info → ⋮ menu → “Allow restricted settings”.
A 4-digit PIN you need to leave kids mode. Don’t make it easy, like 1234.
Type the PIN again to confirm
The PINs don’t match — try again
YouTube isn’t installed on this phone
Kids mode is on. To exit: long-press the top-left corner of the screen for 3 seconds, then enter the PIN.
Long-press the top-left corner of the screen (above the clock) for 3 seconds. The keypad appears; enter your PIN. After 5 wrong tries the keypad locks for a full minute.
Tap “Skip” automatically as soon as it appears
Mute the sound for the whole ad
Always works inside YouTube, even outside kids mode. Ads that can’t be skipped are only muted until they end.
Close Shorts automatically in kids mode
Any Short the child opens closes at once and goes back to Home. Works in kids mode only.
Also allow the YouTube Kids app
Tip: YouTube Kids has only content made for young children, and is better than regular YouTube at this age.

1. In the app’s permissions, turn on “Display pop-up windows while running in the background”. Without it the app can’t bring the child back to YouTube.
2. Turn on “Autostart”.
3. Set battery saver to “No restrictions”.
4. Don’t turn on the “Accessibility shortcut” for the service, because pressing it turns the service off.
